comment: What the probe trace of Steam's Japanese Biohazard.exe (app 4249100) showed behaving as described (tools/Lockpick.Probe trace, 10 min, 2026-10-26, owner playing a Jill game from 10:54 of game time: 1F and 2F, four trips on the stairs, Beretta and grenade fights, bites, a first aid spray, the item box, combining clips, loading acid rounds, pickups). Applied by tools/re1/port_profile.py --live. Fields not listed stay static; mainMenu wasn't shown (never at the title).

fields.stage: 0 on 1F, 1 on 2F, back and forth four times at the stairs.
fields.room: 05, 04, 05, 06, then 03, 04 on 2F, 06, 07, 0B, 18 … (34 changes), at each door.
fields.camera: 151 changes, at the camera cuts while walking.
fields.hp: 96, then 86, 76, 66, 56 in steps of 10 from bites; back to 96 the moment the first aid spray left the inventory.
fields.character: 1 (Jill) the whole trace, with Jill's inventory (inventoryPtr) and health.
fields.gameTimer: Counted from 19 638 to 36 431 frames (10:54 to 20:14 of game time) over 10 min of play.
fields.positionX: Changes as the player walks (trace context).
fields.positionZ: Changes as the player walks (trace context).
fields.inv1: Beretta (0x02), its rounds one fewer per shot (10 → 2, reloaded to 15, down again).
fields.inv1Qty: The Beretta's rounds, one fewer per shot, at the moments an enemy's HP fell.
fields.inv2: First aid spray (0x41), then the next item moved up when the spray was used (HP back to 96 at the same moment).
fields.inv3: A Clip (0x0B x15) used down to 2 when reloading, then other items as picked up (Herbicide 0x26).
fields.inv4: Clips taken from the box and combined (15, 30, then 21, 10, 3 as reloaded), later the Bazooka loaded with Acid rounds (0x07 became 0x08).
fields.inv5: A Clip from the box, a Green herb (0x44), Acid rounds, the Bazooka's rounds counting down.
fields.inv6: Acid rounds (0x11 x6) picked up, then the Bazooka, then another pickup.
fields.inv7: Jill's 8th slot: the Bazooka (0x07) with 6 rounds counting down per grenade, later a Clip.
fields.inv7Qty: 6 → 5 → 4 → 3 → 2, one per grenade; 15 for the Clip.
fields.equippedSlot: 2 (Beretta), 8 (the Bazooka in slot 8), 2, 6, 5, 0 as items moved.
fields.enemy0Hp: Fell in steps of 12 at the moments the Beretta's rounds dropped (0x3A, 0x2E, 0x22, 0x16, 0x0A); below zero when the enemy died.
fields.enemy1Hp: Fell in steps of 12 at the shots (0x4C, 0x40, 0x34 …), then below zero (dead).
fields.enemy0Type: Changed with the room (0x11 researcher zombie, 0x00 zombie, 0x22 Barry, 0x26, 0x0F plant, 0x02 dog).
fields.enemy1Type: Changed with the room (0x25 Kenneth, 0x11, 0x05 crows, 0x0F, 0x02).
fields.flagRoomItems0: A bit cleared at each moment an item appeared in the inventory (Herbicide, Acid rounds, the Bazooka, another pickup).
fields.box0: 0x0F0B (Clip x15), the box's starting item; empty when it was taken out; the Bazooka (0x0608) stored at the end.
fields.box1: A second Clip x15, empty when it was taken out.

addresses.inventoryPointer: Holds the inventory's address (0xC38814) during Jill's game.
addresses.inventory: The slots above, as picked up, combined, loaded and used.
addresses.itemBox: Its first entries: the box's starting Clips, taken out, then the Bazooka stored.
addresses.actorSlots: Slots 0–5: types and HP above (zombies, dogs, crows, plants hit by the Beretta and grenades, then dead).
